blocks.p: Recommendations and workspace settings do not enforce enterprise policy. Twelve required extensions and the optional thirteenth are accepted in the actual intended approved profile, not inferred from a list.

sections.title: The actual phase and approval flow

ol: Phase 0: actual prerequisites, policy/source/profile approval and safe clone review.
Phase 1: read-only Preflight, optional pre-setup inventory gaps kept explicit.
Phase 2: independently confirmed installed-first modules; no global tweaks or silent upgrades.
Phase 3: save/reopen when needed, Verify and genuine profile/source acceptance.
Phase 4: explicit human Dependencies Restore, then daily no-restore Test/Lint/Coverage.
Phase 5: human local/debug/container launch only with existing prerequisites; real synthetic requests.
Phase 6: separately authorized GitHub sign-in, diff, commit/publish/PR, review and exact-SHA CI.
Phase 7: optional current-main manual request, modern gates, same-run image digests, independent approval and existing namespace deployment.

blocks.p: Repository code readiness does not prove laptop readiness. Setup never authenticates/restores projects/launches/deploys. Push/PR never deploys. A stopped partial setup is neither successful base/resume nor a rollback.

head: Contract
Invariant
rows: Arithmetic
Decimal/BigDecimal or exact integer/rational arithmetic; never binary floating point for money
Rounding/serialization
Explicit ROUND_HALF_UP/half-up; monetary JSON is fixed two-decimal strings
INR display
Indian lakh/crore grouping, separate from numeric calculation
Existing EMI
Rounded EMI times tenure defines total_payment; preserve it during schedule work
Schedule exercise
Preserve rounded EMI; prepayment after specified regular payment; shorten tenure, never reduce EMI; last installment equals remaining principal plus rounded interest
IFSC
Synthetic syntax-only normalization/validation; no bank/branch/account/payment existence proof
FX
Fixed synthetic USD/EUR/GBP rates to INR, not market data; exact integer paise rounding
Privacy
No raw request/query logging; mask PAN/Aadhaar/mobile/account patterns and return safe stable errors

blocks.p: The existing EMI rounded-total convention is not silently recalculated or clamped for tiny inputs. Edge validation/rounding boundaries and health need focused tests with every behavior change.

ul: Auto selects wslc first; Docker is considered only if wslc is absent. Explicit selection probes only the approved selected runtime, never fallback after failure/denial.
Local image build/acquisition is only explicitly confirmed Restore ContainerImages. RunContainer inspects an existing image and uses --pull=never.
F5 requires existing pinned/approved debugger and project readiness, no hidden helpers or synchronization.
Missing prerequisites are NOT RUN. Offline mode alone does not prove no cached restoration.
Cleanup retains shared tools/accounts/distros/environments/modules/caches/source/cloud. It is not workstation uninstall or demo reset.

sections.title: Existing-AKS trust and safe source history

blocks.p: Only current reviewed main can dispatch the protected manual delivery workflow. Modern CI and distinct identities precede same-run immutable digests; independently verified aks-demo review precedes namespace deployment. Unavailable/unverifiable live protections fail closed.

Revised main has no Go serving-code exceptions. Deliberate query-logging/internal-error examples are isolated non-serving training text. Historical demo-baseline is retained but unsafe and never runnable/deployable; inspect demo-complete for the schedule fallback only.

callout.text: These architecture controls are documented source intent plus scoped hosted evidence, not this laptop's runtime acceptance, production security assessment or observed Azure deployment.

evidence_gaps: No live laptop lifecycle, runtime health, source/profile acceptance or cloud deployment is proven by this reference page.
